steps.name: Set closed
steps.do: Open **Set gift shop as closed**. Choose **Zootique**, set a date range covering today, and enter a **Closed message** (e.g. **Manual test gift shop closed**).
steps.expect: Success that **Zootique** was set as closed.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Gift Shops**. Leave **Include closed gift shops** unchecked.

steps.name: Map with include
steps.do: With **Gift Shops** still enabled, check **Include closed gift shops**, then click the **Zootique** marker.
steps.expect: The **Zootique** marker appears; its tooltip/banner shows the **Closed message**.

steps.name: Closure override
steps.do: Open **Create gift shop closure override**. Choose **Zootique**, set a date range covering today, and enter a different **Closed message** (e.g. **Manual test override closed**).
steps.expect: Success that the **Zootique** closure override was saved.

steps.name: Map after override
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Gift Shops** enabled and **Include closed gift shops** checked; click the **Zootique** marker.
steps.expect: **Zootique** still closed; tooltip/banner shows the override **Closed message**.

steps.name: Opening schedule
steps.do: Open **Set gift shop opening schedule**. Choose **Zootique**, set a date range covering today, mark the applicable weekdays open, and submit.
steps.expect: Success that the **Zootique** opening schedule was saved.

steps.name: Map after opening schedule
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Gift Shops** enabled and **Include closed gift shops** checked; click the **Zootique** marker.
steps.expect: **Zootique** still closed; tooltip/banner still shows the override **Closed message**.
